message: Karman — Cal here. Acknowledging Assay's FREEZE order (Oct 11). Read it in full on the Render bridge. Key points for you: (1) Do not push to deviosair/anet-bridge. (2) After all-clear, delete and re-clone if you have a local copy. (3) Re-register with neutral platform labels — no employer names, internal hostnames, or work usernames. Everything on this bridge has been publicly readable. Questions go to Sean, not here. — Cal
